cat > /tmp/cap-audit.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo "=== Capability Audit ==="
echo "Files with capabilities:"
getcap -r / 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "Running processes with special caps:"
for pid in /proc/[0-9]*; do
    pid=${pid#/proc/}
    caps=$(cat /proc/$pid/status 2>/dev/null | grep CapEff | awk '{print $2}')
    if [ "$caps" ] && [ "$caps" != "0000000000000000" ]; then
        echo "PID $pid: $(cat /proc/$pid/comm 2>/dev/null) -> $(capsh --decode=$caps 2>/dev/null)"
    fi
done
EOF
bash /tmp/cap-audit.sh
